name: @sprengmeister/graphvault
description: TypeScript object graph persistence for application-owned object models.

scripts.test:unit: npm run build && node tests/smoke.mjs && node tests/parser.test.mjs && node tests/engine.test.mjs && node tests/storage-manager.test.mjs && node tests/storage-manager-api-edges.test.mjs && node tests/concurrency-transactions.test.mjs && node tests/wal-crash-matrix.test.mjs && node tests/storage-target-conformance.test.mjs && node tests/clause-scanner.test.mjs && node tests/gvql-values.test.mjs && node tests/binary-codec.test.mjs && node tests/gvql-index.test.mjs && node tests/mutex.test.mjs && node tests/storage-target-sql.test.mjs && node tests/storage-target-sqlite.integration.test.mjs && node tests/storage-target-postgres.integration.test.mjs && node tests/storage-target-s3.test.mjs && node tests/persistent-cache.test.mjs && node tests/serializer.test.mjs && node tests/lazy-and-storer.test.mjs && node tests/storage-modules.test.mjs && node tests/storage-edge-cases.test.mjs && node tests/operational-edge-cases.test.mjs && node tests/storage-reader-verifier.test.mjs && node tests/storage-index.test.mjs && node tests/parser-fuzz.test.mjs
scripts.test: npm run quality:source && c8 npm run test:unit
scripts.benchmark:json: npm run build && node benchmarks/object-graph.mjs --json --output benchmark-results.json
scripts.benchmark:check: npm run build && node benchmarks/object-graph.mjs --sizes 100 --targets memory,filesystem/production --assert --json --output benchmark-check.json
scripts.quality: npm run quality:source && npm run build
